objective: Determine whether the simplest full-page PP-OCRv6 Small title provider already satisfies the frozen PP1 title-consistency requirement, using a corrected candidate-selection policy and repeated calibration stability evidence.

audit_correction.defect: The historical _selection_eligible() rule required a candidate to contain an optimization feature (an explicit CPU thread count plus MKL-DNN or a cropped fast region) before it could be selected. A complexity-rank-0 full-page candidate that satisfied every prospective requirement was therefore excluded from selection.
audit_correction.correction: Eligibility depends only on whether a candidate satisfies the prospectively frozen requirements. Preference is lowest architectural complexity first, then measured worst-repeat stability.
audit_correction.historical_evidence_treatment: PR #213 and PR #215 modules, corpora, evidence and consumed holdouts are immutable and are never rerun, reinterpreted or tuned against.

excluded_architectures.cropped_region_fast_path: The PR #215 36% title crop introduced false fast-path acceptance; no crop of any ratio is part of this candidate family.
excluded_architectures.multi_pass_ocr: One OCR pass per case keeps the measured latency attributable and the provider simple.
excluded_architectures.backend_specific_acceleration: MKL-DNN is already recorded as not deployable on the supported native Windows runtime (Paddle/oneDNN executor incompatibility).
excluded_architectures.high_performance_inference_or_document_v: HPI is not appropriate for the supported native Windows environment and must not become a new deployment dependency.

selector_policy.decision_rule: keep the merged baseline selector unless the new calibration corpus demonstrates a generalizable defect; otherwise adopt the smallest permitted alternative that removes it
improvement_constraints: metadata-blind during candidate extraction and ranking
no case identifier, consumed holdout wording, project title or learned coordinate
selector_policy.decided_by: one diagnostic OCR pass over the new calibration corpus, replayed through every permitted selector before any candidate repeat is measured

title_contract.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, Unicode dash/quote folding, bounded punctuation-to-space, whitespace collapse

repeatability.rationale: Earlier iterations showed substantial runtime variation between separate experiments, so no candidate may be selected from a single lucky timing run.

host_load_control.metric: system-wide CPU utilisation minus this benchmark process's own share
host_load_control.rationale: This benchmark runs on a shared developer workstation. A repeat measured while an unrelated workload occupies the CPU characterises the host rather than the candidate, so external load is sampled before and throughout every repeat and a contaminated repeat can never satisfy the calibration margin.
host_load_control.rejected_attempt_handling: A measurement whose host-load control failed is a rejected attempt, not a repeat. It is preserved as evidence and the repeat is measured again, up to the attempt bound, so a host artefact can never exclude a candidate the way the superseded eligibility rule excluded one. Only the host-load control may trigger a re-measurement; a repeat that failed on any candidate metric stands as recorded.

selection_rule.eligibility: a candidate is eligible if and only if it satisfies every quality, safety, operational, security and provisioning requirement and the stronger calibration margin on every required repeat; eligibility never depends on whether a candidate contains an optimization feature
selection_rule.principle: The simplest candidate that meets the requirement must be preferred; a more sophisticated strategy is never chosen merely because it is faster.

security.model_paths: explicit operator-provisioned local directories with frozen tree hashes
